## Review Scope

This payload supports one decision: approve, repair, or decline the bounded
Gate-0 registration-preparation candidate. It also exposes the later gate
architecture, every unavailable binding, access/firewall rules, and the future
qualified-method record shape.

It does not support authorization of empirical development, data processing,
tuning, held-out qualification, a recurrence or method, implementation change,
Stage B, validation, readiness, production, fallback, or Unity work.

## Acceptance Rule

Approval must name both
`SCI-FRUIT-EL-G0-REGISTRATION-PREPARATION-R0.1` and this exact manifest (or an
explicit successor). The owner's instruction to prepare the packet is not
approval of its decision candidate.
